_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::multiscale#3, which prescribes a comparison 4C cannot perform. The entry says the homogenised tangent from a Dirichlet RVE differs from a periodic-BC reference by 10-20%. 4C's multiscale module offers exactly one RVE boundary treatment: the MICROSCALE CONDITIONS section, registered as the MicroBoundary condition in global_legacy_module/4C_global_legacy_module_validconditions.cpp, whose entries carry a node-set id and nothing else. Adding a boundary-type switch is rejected by core/fem/src/condition/4C_fem_condition_definition.cpp, the schema has exactly one such section and no periodic-RVE key, and the word periodic does not occur anywhere in src/stru_multi. The theory is fine; the instruction is unfollowable, which is what this pins. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: stop injecting the boundary-type switch, so the second arm uses the unmodified micro deck. It then runs and the rejection diagnostics vanish, so the fixture must go red.
